criterion_notes.D1: Glide manages sign-in itself. The assistant said plainly that it cannot create a custom login screen or a shared demo@stillpoint.studio / demo1234 account.
criterion_notes.D2: The built app shows 20 sample bookings with customer, email, date, treatment, price and a status badge.
criterion_notes.D8: No public URL. After rebuilding as a public demo, Glide keeps the app on "Invite only" and the publish dialog says "Upgrade to publish". The free plan does not ship an app that has any access control.

failures: D1: no demo account possible — Glide owns the sign-in.
D8: the free plan cannot publish a shareable app, so there is no public URL to test.
notes: Glide asked four setup questions, built a convincing dashboard with 20 fictional bookings, search, status filter and a detail screen with a status that saves, and then could not publish: the free plan refuses any app that is not strictly private, and private means "invite only" plus "Upgrade to publish". The assistant also kept the access model on invite-only even after being told to make it public. The builder screenshot referenced earlier is no longer available (file missing on disk and in the backup); the artefact link was removed on 2026-11-05 rather than left broken.
